thousands.context: Compact chart axis label for thousands: 12400 becomes '12.4k'. {value} is the number of thousands. Keep it very short.

everythingElse.context: Spending donut chart: the slice that groups the smaller categories together. {count} is how many categories it holds.

askQuestion.context: Question pre-filled in the AI chat from the Insights tab; {month} is the name alone.

empty.message: Nothing to chart yet. Add a few expenses and come back.

paceTitle.context: Insights: pace chart card title (current month).

paceThrough.context: Insights: pace chart card title for a past month.

evenSpread.context: Insights: legend of the dashed pace line.

withinLimits.context: Insights: KPI note, within the total limits. Lowercase.

vs.context: Insights: KPI label comparing with last month; {month} is the name alone.

vsSameDays.context: Insights: KPI label comparing the same days of last month.

noDataFor.context: Insights: KPI when last month has no data.

moreThanLast.context: Insights: KPI under the percentage. Lowercase.

lessThanLast.context: Insights: KPI under the percentage. Lowercase.

sameAsLast.context: Insights: KPI under the percentage. Lowercase.

youSpent.context: Insights pace card headline, past month without limits.

endedOver.context: Insights pace card headline, past month.

endedUnder.context: Insights pace card headline, past month.

finishOver.message: At this rate you'll finish about {amount} over your limits.
finishOver.context: Insights pace card headline. Keep the <b> tags.

finishUnder.message: At this rate you'll finish about {amount} under your limits.
finishUnder.context: Insights pace card headline. Keep the <b> tags.

monthByMonthEmpty.message: Shows up once you have two months of expenses. A single month is just the number above.
monthByMonthEmpty.context: Insights: month-by-month card with one month of data.

onCourseAbove.message: {month} is on course to finish {percent}% above your average month.
onCourseAbove.context: Insights month-by-month headline. Keep the <b> tags.

onCourseBelow.message: {month} is on course to finish {percent}% below your average month.
onCourseBelow.context: Insights month-by-month headline. Keep the <b> tags.

wasAbove.context: Insights month-by-month headline, past month. Keep the <b> tags.

wasBelow.context: Insights month-by-month headline, past month. Keep the <b> tags.

monthlyLimits.context: Insights: legend of the dashed limit line.

totalChartLabel.context: Insights: accessible label of the monthly chart.

limitsShort.context: Insights: short label on the chart's dashed line. Very short, lowercase.

soFar.context: Insights: chart tooltip row for the running month.

changeEmpty.message: Compares each category with the month before. Nothing logged in {month} yet.
changeEmpty.context: Insights: change card when last month has no data.

biggestJump.context: Insights change card headline. Keep the <b> tags.

biggestJumpSameDays.message: Biggest jump: {name}, +{amount} vs the same days of {month}.
biggestJumpSameDays.context: Insights change card headline, running month. Keep the <b> tags.

allDown.message: Every category is down, most of all {name}.
allDown.context: Insights change card headline. Keep the <b> tags.

moreThan.context: Insights change card legend; {month} is e.g. 'Aug 1-21'.

inProgress.context: Insights people chart: legend of the dashed segment.

whoSpent.context: Insights: chart card title, spending per person.

trendLater.message: The trend line appears after a second month.
trendLater.context: Insights people card with one month of data.

priciestDay.message: Your priciest day is {day}, about {amount} on average.
priciestDay.context: Insights weekday headline; {day} is a weekday name (e.g. 'Saturday', Polish nominative 'sobota'). Keep the <b> tags.

average.context: Insights: table header and tooltip row.

weekdayChartLabel.context: Insights: accessible label of the weekday chart.

weekdayNote.one: Average per day since your first expense, over the last month.
weekdayNote.other: Average per day since your first expense, over the last {count} months.

weekdayExcluded.one: Leaves out {count} expense of {amount} or more, like rent.
weekdayExcluded.other: Leaves out {count} expenses of {amount} or more, like rent.
weekdayExcluded.context: Insights weekday card footnote: big expenses are excluded.
